lore.block.deep_aether.chromatic_aerclou: The result of alchemizing a Sterling Aercloud. Is used to create Stratus ingots.
lore.block.deep_aether.sterling_aercloud: This Aercloud forms similarly high to Golden Aerclouds. When stepped on, lightning turns it into a Cold Aercloud. Can be used in an Alchemy Table to create a Chromatic Aercloud.
lore.item.deep_aether.gravitite_ring: A powerful pendant that boosts the Stratus Armor's dash and Gravitite Armor's boosted jump.
lore.item.deep_aether.stratus_ring: An upgraded variant of the Gravitite Pendant.
lore.item.deep_aether.stratus_gloves: An upgrade to the Gravitite Gloves, needed to complete the Stratus set.
lore.item.deep_aether.stratus_ingot: Crafted from Chromatic Aerclouds and other ingredients. Use in a Smithing Table to upgrade Gravitite gear!
